text:
mira: quick sync - proposing a lightweight permission + canary policy for runtime config changes. intent: allow fast owner changes for low-risk flags but enforce approval + telemetry gates for routing/quota/privacy.

kevin: thumbs up. need concrete cutoffs. propose: low <1% traffic & no region change => owner auto; medium 1-5% or affects quota buckets => owner + product; high >5% or privacy flag => owner + SRE + Security.

jamal: add tenant-count threshold: >30 tenants => escalate same as >5%. also require dry-run default 0.05% for privacy=true.

tara: console UX: show a single line risk badge (Low/Med/High) with an expand for details: axes (traffic, quota, privacy), suggested approvers, and auto-canary plan. small CTA to request expedited approval.

ops-bot: PRECHECK: schema validated, est_impact=3.2%, tenants=12, privacy=false, risk=0.28, approvers=["owner","product"], suggested_canary=[{"step":1,"frac":"0.001"}].

kevin: telemetry gates for auto-rollback: p50 increase >35% (15m), error rate +1pp and >3x baseline (1h), quota burn >140% predicted. security gate: any new external egress pauses rollout.

mira: API change plan: add v2 apply fields: "risk_level","approvers","dry_run_fraction","canary_plan","revert_token". audit log show approver comments and immutable snapshot id. I'll wire up copy for the badge.

jamal: one more: allow team-admins to nominate delegated approvers but require MFA and audit cooldown (24h) before they can approve high changes.

mira: thanks — I'll update the PR with thresholds, default dry-run, v2 fields and console mock. react :thumbsup: if you agree and i'll merge after thumbs-up.

kevin: +1

tara: +1

ops-bot: NOTE: created issue #812 in infra-telemetry to add the 15m/1h gating metrics to approval index.
